antithesis: We can conclude that transcranial 870nm at 345 THz with low irradiance 22.2 mW/cm2 for 40 minutes is the most effective strategy validated by the 2025 paper showing ATP increases 28%
synthesis: I believe that exposing keratinocytes to 8300nm light at 36 THz could repair mitochondrial damage in PDH complex
conclusion: But prolonged exposure at 8300nm might generate too much heat and damage surrounding tissue in keratinocytes
forward_action: But prolonged exposure at 8300nm might generate too much heat and damage surrounding tissue in keratinocytes
